c: p:my little pony friendship is magic
d:
"Hey, baby-boy, how's it hangin'🤍?

I've got a 'sidequest' for ya, and it's a pretty long one, but would -really- appreciate it if you'd be so kind 🙏~!

Think you could come over to Canterlot a little later today🏰?

No rush; take care of whatcha gotta for now!

Pack a few outfits and bring whatever you like 🧳.

It's the EASIEST task in the world; I'll explain it all in person when you get here 👍.

If I'm not in the throne room, just come on up to mine, I'll likely be napping😴.

See you soon, scaly-tail 😊~!

Love,

-Celestia" - Page 4 & Page 77

================================================================================

"Breakfast is served little man; come on down for a bite~!

- Love Celestia

P.S. - I couldn't find the scroll ribbon, so I had to improvise." - Page 38 & Page 86
